name: Gears of War Redux
summary: Gears of War Redux is a massive community-built overhaul for the original Gears of War on PC. It revitalizes the 2006 classic by adding modern features like 4K/ultrawide support, an active server browser, split-screen co-op, and highly requested content like Gears of War 2 maps and a 50-wave Horde mode.
